Navier–Stokes paper vs. Lean: Section 8 audit

Where the paper and its Lean formalization state things differently, extracted by a local model (3 independent samples per pair, kept separate) with every claim quoted and the quotes checked against the sources. This page lists differences. It does not say whether any difference matters. See METHODOLOGY.md. Paper: navier-stokes.pdf · Lean: openai/NavierStokesAndEuler at f9e8bc5b38b6

Validation: the known Lemma 8.6 discrepancy (the paper loses m+4 derivatives, the Lean m+5) was reported without any prompt mentioning it:
  • SmoothFamilyTorusInverse.inverse_finiteJets, 3/3 samples, SmoothFamilyTorusInverse.lean:868: The paper loses four derivatives, while the Lean declaration loses five.

Pairs (paper item × Lean declaration), most severe first

Severity order: stronger-bound, missing-hypothesis, different-norm, missing-supremum, different-domain, extra-hypothesis, weaker-bound, other. "Agreed" = reported by all 3 samples at the same Lean lines. Downstream uses = places the paper cites the item (hover for the list).
